question.prompt: The number \(2024\) is written as the sum of not necessarily distinct two-digit numbers. What is the least number of two-digit numbers needed to write this sum?

solutions.title: Bound the sum and reach it
solutions.explanation:
Each two-digit number is at most \(99\). Therefore, a sum with \(20\) or fewer terms is at most
\[
20\cdot99=1980<2024.
\]
So at least \(21\) terms are necessary. This number is attainable because
\[
2024=20\cdot99+44,
\]
which uses twenty copies of \(99\) and one \(44\), all two-digit numbers.

The least number of terms is \(\boxed{21}\), choice \(\text{B}\).
